title: The Weight of the Crown
logline: A newly crowned young king navigates the overwhelming responsibilities of his position, finding both challenge and quiet strength.

characters.name: King Alaric
characters.one_line_description: A young, thoughtful monarch grappling with the immense duties of his throne.

characters.name: Advisor Elara
characters.one_line_description: A wise and seasoned royal advisor, offering counsel to the young king.

scenes.title: The Coronation's Echo
scenes.summary: Quick, impactful shots of King Alaric's coronation, highlighting the ceremonial weight of the crown settling upon his head.

scenes.title: Council's Demands
scenes.summary: King Alaric sits at a long table, listening intently to Advisor Elara and other unseen council members, his face showing the strain of complex decisions.

scenes.title: A King's Solitude
scenes.summary: King Alaric walks alone through the quiet, torch-lit corridors of the castle, deep in thought, the sounds of his footsteps echoing.

scenes.title: Kingdom's Horizon
scenes.summary: King Alaric stands on a high balcony, looking out over his vast kingdom at sunset, the vastness of his responsibility clearly weighing on him.

scenes.title: Quiet Resolve
scenes.summary: King Alaric sits at his desk, a scroll and quill before him. He looks up, a newfound determination in his eyes, ready to face the challenges ahead.
